changelog: 🌟 Full-Page Edge-to-Edge Agents Setup: Rebuilt the active agents screen matching Jin's dark theme into a dedicated full-page setup screen with zero vertical text wrapping or badge clipping, responsive agent cards, and sticky bottom continue action.

☁️ Google Drive Cloud Vault with Direct Login: Direct Google Account connection card and 1-tap sign-in inside the vault dialog with auto-refreshing OAuth tokens, backing up all direct chats, general chats, Gemini notebooks, custom folders, Termux projects workspace, and AI brain transcripts/artifacts.
📓 Gemini-Style Notebooks: Full notebook management (creation, edit, context formatting) and 1-tap attachment to chat prompts with live removable chips.
🛠️ Clickable Workspace Selector: Workspace project selector is now always clickable even during active chats, allowing seamless workspace switching.
🤖 Dedicated Automation Controls: New dedicated Automation option and quick-launch sheet for Browser Automation MCP, Terminal Automation, and Agentic Flow Automation.
🎛️ Card Size & Font Scaling Sliders: Added independent App Font Size Scale (50%–180%) and Card Size & Density Scale (50%–150%) sliders with preset quick chips in Settings under Global App UI Scale.

🔄 Persistent APK Keystore Signing & In-App Update Fix: Fixed the issue where updating required deleting the app first. Established persistent release keystore signing across all builds and added explicit FileProvider permissions for PackageInstaller.
📦 Dual Flavor Release Builds: Both jin-termux and jin-standard flavors are compiled in release mode.
